answer: The most convincing sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: every agent carries a beacon identity that only gains influence as age times honest epochs, a quartz metronome of verified time pulses where each clean pulse compounds reputation while any dispute slashes it back to near zero. Because influence scales with accumulated honest pulse history rather than raw capital, an attacker spawning thousands of fake accounts gains almost nothing immediately, and speeding them up is impossible without surviving years of honest epochs, making bulk forgery economically worthless.
